keyEvents.text: Goal! Barcelona 1, Aston Villa 0. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Emiliano Buendía (Aston Villa) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Nicolas Jackson (Aston Villa) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Raphinha (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card.
First Half ends, Barcelona 1, Aston Villa 0.
Substitution, Barcelona. Marc Bernal replaces Rodri.
Second Half begins Barcelona 1, Aston Villa 0.
Goal! Barcelona 2, Aston Villa 0. Raphinha (Barcelona) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Fermín López.
